therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with probable Alzheimer's disease previously treated with donepezil
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: number of participants who discontinued from the study due to any reason during the core phase (Week 5)

results.effect_size: 11 discontinuations (immediate switch) vs 10 discontinuations (delayed switch) during core phase
subgroup_findings: CGIC at Week 5: immediate switch 3.9, delayed switch 4.0
CGIC at Week 25: immediate switch 4.1, delayed switch 4.3
MMSE change at Week 25: immediate switch -0.7, delayed switch -0.4
MMSE change at end of study: immediate switch -0.5, delayed switch -0.3
NPI-10 change at Week 25: immediate switch -0.1, delayed switch +0.4
NPI-10 change at end of study: immediate switch -0.8, delayed switch +0.5
ADCS-ADL change at Week 25: immediate switch -3.9, delayed switch -4.2
ADCS-ADL change at end of study: immediate switch -3.1, delayed switch -4.2
safety_signals: 23 participants in immediate switch arm discontinued due to AE over 25 weeks vs 15 in delayed switch arm
32 participants in immediate switch arm discontinued for any reason during extension phase vs 26 in delayed switch arm
Serious adverse events included bradycardia, myocardial infarction, coronary artery disease, pneumonia, sepsis, and others

dose_info.dose: 4.6 mg/24h (5 cm^2 patch) or 9.5 mg/24h (10 cm^2 patch)

context.comparator: delayed switch (rivastigmine patch after 4-week donepezil continuation)

results_by_chain.endpoint: discontinuation due to any reason (core phase, Week 5)
results_by_chain.population_description: patients with probable Alzheimer's disease previously treated with donepezil, immediately switched to rivastigmine patch
